French

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]
Etymology tree
Proto-Indo-European *ís?
Proto-Indo-European *h₁óynos
Proto-Italic *oinos
Old Latin oinos
Latin ūnus
Proto-Indo-European *-teh₂
Proto-Indo-European *-ts
Proto-Indo-European *-teh₂ts
Proto-Italic *-tāts
Latin -tās
Latin ūnitāsslbor.
Old French unité
French unité

    Inherited from Old French unité.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • IPA(key): /y.ni.te/
    • Audio (Paris):(file)
    • Audio (Canada (Shawinigan)):(file)
    • Audio (France (Paris)):(file)
    • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)
    • Audio (France (Somain)):(file)
    • Rhymes: -e
    • Homophone: unités

    Noun

    [edit]

    unité f (plural unités)

    1. unity
    2. unit
    3. (in the plural) ones (in arithmetic)

    Derived terms

    [edit]
    • cercle unité
    • Système international d'unités
    • unité astronomique
    • unité centrale
    • unité de lieux
    • unité de sens
    • unité de temps

    Related terms

    [edit]

    Further reading

    Old French

    [edit]

    Etymology

    [edit]

      Semi-learned borrowing from Latin ūnitās, from ūnus (“one”) +‎ -tās (“-ness”).

      Noun

      [edit]

      unité oblique singular, f (oblique plural unitez, nominative singular unité, nominative plural unitez)

      1. unity (quality of being united)

      Descendants

      [edit]
      • French: unité
      • → Middle English: unite
        • English: unity
        • Scots: unitie
